_about: US shops whose full catalog the weekly directory job scans for new bottles (Shopify stores only: they publish /products.json). Order matters: earlier shops are preferred when several stock the same bottle. 'producerFrom' says where the shop puts the producer name: 'title' (text before the first ' - '), 'vendor', or 'tag:Producer_'. 'skipVendors' drops stock that is not shipped from the US.
